mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales indicates broad-based consumer weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% in the last month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production growth (negative for two consecutive months) signals a supply shock, reducing corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO growth is negative for two consecutive months, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth and decrease in unemployment rate indicates a tight labor market, which may lead to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases by more than 100k and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp in the last month, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by GDP growth above 2% and slowing from prior quarter, strong corporate earnings support positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2% and declining from prior quarter
failure_condition: When GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2% and is declining from the prior quarter, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.
